competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times and deals damage proportionate to your Defense. Each attack has a 25% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn. If the target is not suffering any harmful effects, 1 additional attack is added.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
effets.note: If the target is not suffering any harmful effects

competences.description: Crushes all enemies and decreases the Attack Bar of each enemy by 30%. The damage of this attack is proportionate to your MAX HP and Defense.
Attacks the enemy 4 times and deals damage proportionate to your Defense. 2 additional attacks are added if the enemy's MAX HP is lower than yours and if the target is suffering a harmful effect.

effets.description: Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
effets.note: If the enemy's MAX HP is lower than yours and if the target is suffering a harmful effect
